units.locator: Article 15.15.16. Violation in executing payment documents and a formal demand of a Federal Treasury body
units.text: 1. Failure by a bank or other credit institution to execute, or its late execution of, payment documents for transferring funds to be credited to the accounts of budgets within the budget system of the Russian Federation (except for revenues whose calculation and complete and timely payment (transfer) to the budgets are monitored by tax authorities, customs authorities, governing bodies of state extrabudgetary funds and bodies authorised to perform functions of compulsory enforcement of enforcement documents and ensuring the established procedure for the operation of courts), or for transferring funds of budgets within the budget system of the Russian Federation —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 15.15.16

units.locator: Article 15.15.16. Violation in executing payment documents and a formal demand of a Federal Treasury body
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on legal entities, 1 to 5 per cent of the amount of funds to be credited to the accounts of budgets within the budget system of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 15.15.16 · “shall entail an administrative fine on officials of ten…”

units.locator: Article 15.15.16. Violation in executing payment documents and a formal demand of a Federal Treasury body
units.text: 2. Failure by a bank or other credit institution to comply with a formal demand of a Federal Treasury body to suspend transactions on accounts opened for treasury institutions and budget-funded institutions in violation of the budget legislation of the Russian Federation and other normative legal acts governing budgetary legal relations, or on accounts denominated in the currency of the Russian Federation for recording funds of the budgets of constituent entities of the Russian Federation (municipal entities) opened for the financial authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation (municipal entities), —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 15.15.16

units.locator: Article 15.15.16. Violation in executing payment documents and a formal demand of a Federal Treasury body
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of ten thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on legal entities, 1 to 5 per cent of the amount of funds involved in the unlawfully executed transactions.

units.locator: Article 15.19. Violation of legislative requirements concerning the submission and disclosure of information in financial markets
units.text: 1. Failure by an issuer, professional securities market participant, clearing organisation, joint-stock investment fund, management company of a joint-stock investment fund, unit investment fund or non-state pension fund, or specialised depositary of a joint-stock investment fund, unit investment fund or non-state pension fund to submit information (notifications) required by federal laws and other normative legal acts adopted pursuant to them, or violation of the procedure and time limits for submitting such information (notifications), or submission of incomplete and (or) inaccurate and (or) misleading information, except in the cases provided for in Article 19.7.3 of this Code, where those actions (inaction) do not constitute a criminal offence, —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 15.19

units.locator: Article 15.19. Violation of legislative requirements concerning the submission and disclosure of information in financial markets
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles or disqualification for up to one year; on legal entities, five hundred thousand to seven hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 15.19 · “shall entail an administrative fine on officials of twenty…”

units.locator: Article 15.19. Violation of legislative requirements concerning the submission and disclosure of information in financial markets
units.text: 2. Failure by an issuer, professional securities market participant, clearing organisation, joint-stock investment fund, management company of a joint-stock investment fund, unit investment fund or non-state pension fund, specialised depositary of a joint-stock investment fund, unit investment fund or non-state pension fund, or a person providing services for publicly presenting disclosed information to disclose information required by federal laws and other normative legal acts adopted pursuant to them, or violation of the procedure and time limits for disclosing such information, or disclosure of incomplete and (or) inaccurate and (or) misleading information —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 15.19

units.locator: Article 15.19. Violation of legislative requirements concerning the submission and disclosure of information in financial markets
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles or disqualification for a period of one to two years; on legal entities, seven hundred thousand to one million roubles.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 15.19 · “shall entail an administrative fine on officials of thirty…”

units.locator: Article 15.19. Violation of legislative requirements concerning the submission and disclosure of information in financial markets
units.text: 3. Failure to submit (disclose) information required by federal laws and other normative legal acts adopted pursuant to them, or violation of the procedure and time limits for submitting (disclosing) such information, except in the cases provided for in Article 19.7.3 of this Code, by persons who have provided security for issuers' bonds; persons who have acquired the right, directly or indirectly, independently or jointly with other persons, to dispose of a specified number of votes attached to voting shares (participation interests) constituting the charter capital of issuers or a clearing organisation; organisations controlled by issuers; members (shareholders) of business companies; persons who have acquired the powers necessary to convene and hold extraordinary general meetings of shareholders of joint-stock companies; persons acquiring issue-grade securities of open joint-stock companies pursuant to a voluntary offer, including a competing offer, or a mandatory offer provided for by the legislation of the Russian Federation on joint-stock companies; affiliated persons of joint-stock companies; and persons deemed under federal law to have an interest in a transaction entered into by a joint-stock company —
units.label: Part 3 Art. 15.19

units.locator: Article 15.19. Violation of legislative requirements concerning the submission and disclosure of information in financial markets
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand to two thousand roubles; on officials, ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles; on legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 15.19 · “shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of one thousand…”

units.locator: Article 15.19. Violation of legislative requirements concerning the submission and disclosure of information in financial markets
units.text: 4. Violation by a party to a repurchase agreement, a contract constituting a derivative financial instrument, or a contract of another type specified in Bank of Russia regulations, entered into outside organised trading, of the procedure and (or) time limits established by federal law and (or) Bank of Russia regulations for providing information about those contracts and (or) the master agreement (single contract) to a trade repository or the Bank of Russia, or provision of incomplete and (or) inaccurate information —
units.label: Part 4 Art. 15.19

units.locator: Article 15.19. Violation of legislative requirements concerning the submission and disclosure of information in financial markets
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles; on legal entities, three hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 15.19 · “shall entail an administrative fine on officials of twenty…”

units.locator: Article 15.19. Violation of legislative requirements concerning the submission and disclosure of information in financial markets
units.text: 5. Unlawful refusal or evasion by a trade repository to enter in the register of contracts a record of a repurchase agreement, a contract constituting a derivative financial instrument, or a contract of another type specified in Bank of Russia regulations, entered into outside organised trading, and (or) a master agreement (single contract); or making such an entry without grounds provided for by federal law and (or) Bank of Russia regulations; or entering inaccurate information in the register of contracts; or failure or improper performance by a trade repository of its duty to provide information from the register of contracts, including information to the Bank of Russia; or unlawful acquisition, use or disclosure of information and data included in the register of contracts —
units.label: Part 5 Art. 15.19

units.locator: Article 15.19. Violation of legislative requirements concerning the submission and disclosure of information in financial markets
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine on officials of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, seven hundred thousand to one million roubles.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 15.19 · “shall entail an administrative fine on officials of thirty…”

units.locator: Article 15.19. Violation of legislative requirements concerning the submission and disclosure of information in financial markets
units.text: 6. Other violation by a trade repository, in carrying on trade repository activities, of requirements for those activities established by the legislation of the Russian Federation, except in the cases provided for in Part 5 of this Article, —
units.label: Part 6 Art. 15.19

units.locator: Article 15.19. Violation of legislative requirements concerning the submission and disclosure of information in financial markets

units.text: shall entail an administrative fine on citizens of three thousand to five thousand roubles; on officials, thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles or disqualification for a period of one to two years; on legal entities, the amount of the excess income or the losses avoided by the citizen, official or legal entity as a result of the unlawful use of inside information, but not less than seven hundred thousand roubles.

units.locator: Article 15.21. Unlawful use of inside information
units.text: Notes:
units.label: Art. 15.21 · “Notes:”

units.locator: Article 15.21. Unlawful use of inside information
units.text: 1. In this Article and Article 15.30 of this Code, excess income or the amount of losses a person has avoided as a result of unlawful use of inside information and (or) market manipulation shall be determined as the difference between the income obtained as a result of the unlawful actions and the income that would have arisen without taking into account the unlawful actions provided for in this Article.
units.label: Art. 15.21 · “1. In this Article and Article 15.30 of this Code, excess…”

units.locator: Article 15.21. Unlawful use of inside information
units.text: 2. A person against whom proceedings are being conducted for an administrative offence provided for in this Article or Article 15.30 of this Code shall be exempt from administrative liability if that person performs an agreement entered into with the Bank of Russia and provided for by Federal Law of 27 July 2010 No. 224-FZ "On Counteracting the Unlawful Use of Inside Information and Market Manipulation and on Amendments to Certain Legislative Acts of the Russian Federation".
units.label: Art. 15.21 · “2. A person against whom proceedings are being conducted for an…”

units.locator: Article 15.21. Unlawful use of inside information
units.text: 3. The agreement specified in Note 2 to this Article may be entered into with the Bank of Russia before the day on which a ruling is issued in the case concerning an administrative offence provided for in this Article or Article 15.30 of this Code.
units.label: Art. 15.21 · “3. The agreement specified in Note 2 to this Article may be…”

units.locator: Article 15.21. Unlawful use of inside information
units.text: 4. The agreement specified in Note 2 to this Article shall be signed by the person who chaired the meeting of the Financial Supervision Committee of the Bank of Russia at which the decision to enter into that agreement was adopted. On behalf of a legal entity against which administrative offence proceedings are being conducted, the agreement specified in Note 2 to this Article shall be signed by the legal representative of the legal entity.
units.label: Art. 15.21 · “4. The agreement specified in Note 2 to this Article shall be…”

units.locator: Article 15.21. Unlawful use of inside information
units.text: 5. The agreement specified in Note 2 to this Article shall enter into force on the day on which the Financial Supervision Committee of the Bank of Russia adopts the decision to enter into it.
units.label: Art. 15.21 · “5. The agreement specified in Note 2 to this Article shall…”
